description: Land Title Settlement Department - Bogasela, Gemunupura, Ingammaruwa Lunupitiya, Rajanganaya Yaya 07 etc. Rajanganaya D/S Division, Anuradhapura District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration and determinations regarding specific land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules listing land parcel numbers, extents, ownership details (primarily "The State" and local government bodies), and land classifications. The content focuses entirely on land administration matters, specifically title settlement declarations for multiple land parcels in the Anuradhapura district, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
